ai_review.summary: Beautiful, underrated 9/11/82 West Palm Beach show captured in an excellent 24‑bit soundboard recording.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates this version as the best of the night, praising the high‑resolution 24‑bit mastering and calling the performance beautiful and underrated. While no specific songs are highlighted, the overall tone is enthusiastic, suggesting a high‑energy show that translates well through the crisp recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review gives a clear positive impression of both performance and audio quality; limited data keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: 24‑bit mastering noted as crisp and well‑crafted; reviewer describes it as the best version of the show.
